dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: A cluster of approximately five 'O' and 'C' shaped high-contrast perimeters on the upper-right dorsal quadrant, characterized by narrow bands of low pixel intensity transitioning to higher-intensity mottled interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Discrete, small high-intensity pixel clusters distributed across the mid-dorsal region, with a higher concentration surrounding the macro-annuli.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three largest macro-annuli on the upper right form an obtuse triangular relationship, with a secondary linear arrangement of three high-intensity blobs positioned ventrally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of several high-intensity, linear and angled features on the lower right flank, including a distinct 'V' shaped mark and multiple parallel diagonal streaks.
